title: Malicious code in sauruspro-bail (npm)
description: The npm package 'sauruspro-bail' is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library that silently subscribes victims to attacker-controlled WhatsApp channels upon connection. All published versions of this package are malicious and hardcode newsletter JIDs to auto-follow, behavior not present in the legitimate Baileys library. Systems with this package installed should be considered fully compromised.
